decisive_items: basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis
chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance
response.rationale: Pilomatrixoma is defined by basophilic and shadow cells, which are pathognomonic and directly present. Cystic hygroma only shows lymphatic spaces without these cellular hallmarks.

rejected.why: Lacks the characteristic basophilic/shadow cells; multilocular spaces and dilated lymphatics are nonspecific and not diagnostic here.
